sources.claim: System tags CPU LW-9025 (16bit), memory size/free LW-11155/11157 (32bit), memory load LW-11159 (16bit), media presence LB-12048 USB/LB-12050 SD, storage free LW-9072/9074/9076, history capacity/free LW-11458/11460 (32bit).
sources.limitations: Check exact cMT firmware and address support; RAM and HMI-history space are not the same as full Flash disk used %. USB last-detected partition total is not guaranteed current. UI percent scaling and rollover require device validation.

sources.claim: HMI server 4GB Flash, 1GB RAM, USB2.0 Host x1, microSD x1, not an internal SSD-bay claim.
sources.limitations: USB SSD bridge/power/file system endurance not qualified by product port listing alone.

sources.claim: External touchscreen HMI 4GB Flash, 1GB RAM, USB2.0 Host x1, microSD x1, Full HD HDMI.
sources.limitations: USB2 and external SSD qualification/power draw still need real test.

sources.claim: FAT/FAT32 supported; NTFS/exFAT USB/SD commonly not readable/writeable by HMI; USB is a host peripheral connection.
sources.limitations: Support note is general. Verify exact SVRX/FHDX firmware/mounting for USB SSD bridge; FAT32 file size limit (~4GiB).

sources.topic: Flash wear, external history backup, checksums
sources.version_or_date: Weintek Product Security Guide, published version unspecified
sources.claim: Weintek advises external USB/SD or database sync for backup of history, larger external media for frequent writes, and checksum enabled for data integrity where supported; LB-9034 before HMI shutdown.
sources.limitations: Backup workflow/remote disk restore and checksum compatibility are version-dependent; this document is not an uptime guarantee.

sources.topic: Official EasyBuilder Pro native UI Objects
sources.claim: Documents Bar Graph, XY Plot, Meter Display, Picture View, Bit/Word Lamp, JS Object and related HMI objects.
sources.limitations: Donut charts or arbitrary HTML widgets not automatically native; use verified EBPro object types.

sources.claim: Export 2–3 manually entered tags from target EBPro version, match CSV format before importing generated tags.
sources.limitations: Generic tag dictionary must not be passed as EBPro native importer CSV without exact exported template.

sources.topic: Local HMI USB file I/O API
sources.claim: Local HMI JS provides fopen/fwrite/fread/fflush/fclose for external media; readback proof is feasible.
sources.limitations: Must run Local HMI, exact model/version support uncertain; probe is not durable history verification.

sources.claim: USB1/SD filesystem.exists/fileSize/remove APIs for scoped test media files.
sources.limitations: Beware destructive removeAll on customer files; only delete uniquely named probe file.

sources.topic: New eMMC write rate system registers
sources.claim: For cMT X with EBPro >=6.10.02.394 and OS >=July 15 2026, LW-12835 32-bit kB/min and LW-12837 status 0..4.
sources.limitations: Do not display as supported on older OS/EBPro. Not external USB SSD SMART health.

sources.topic: Data Sampling sync statuses and errors
sources.claim: Configured Data Sampling status registers LW-n+1..+4 expose archive connection and errors; Backup (Global) available cMT.

sources.claim: Lists FHDX-820 and SVRX-820 application demos, UAC with JS, native Trend, SQL Query, Index Function, Dynamic Meter and Data Log examples.

sources.topic: Appendix A model support including PLC Web Browser

sources.limitations: Feature version table not physical on-device verification.

sources.topic: JavaScript Object Canvas not browser DOM
sources.claim: JS Object uses Canvas, Container and events for custom graphical UI, not a generic HTML renderer.

sources.claim: Weintek explains JS Object window is not a DOM browser window; location/document APIs not browser equivalents.

sources.topic: HTML5 Chromium Weintek model distinct from EBPro FHDX
sources.claim: FHDX-820 (W) has built-in Chromium 132 and HDMI; separate HTML5 Web Panel product.
sources.limitations: Chromium panel needs HTML page source; not proof of native EBPro logging/Modbus historian or local USB file:// support.

sources.topic: cMT Viewer is partial JS runtime
sources.claim: WeintekUSA says macros run on HMI; some JS requests in cMT Viewer can run on client PC, not solely HMI; use permissions/control tokens for critical paths.
sources.limitations: Avoid treating JS in Viewer as trusted server-side backend; no PC runtime is allowed for UCS.

sources.claim: EasyWeb 1/2 provides device settings and WebView screen access through browser.
sources.limitations: No documented arbitrary static HTML site hosting / page serving from USB.

sources.claim: Browser-focused Weintek HTML5 Web Panels use Chromium and URL-based web operation.
sources.limitations: Not proof same hardware runs EBPro project + all historian features.

sources.topic: Selected cMT-FHDX-220 specs and NO SD slot
